# The negative fixture for the F19 parser gate (ctest: knvstd_input_check_rejects,
# registered WILL_FAIL because --input-check must exit 2 on this file).

# command, so the loader must stop with "unknown command 'teleport'" and

# number has to point at what the operator sees in their editor).

30 key tab up
